name: agentpay-safe-spend
description: Prompt-injection-aware discovery, policy, authorization, and outcome handling for AI-agent purchases.

interface.shortDescription: Keep product content separate from spending authority.
interface.longDescription: One Codex bundle for untrusted shopping discovery, pre-confirmation policy, wallet-bound AgentPay authorization, and accurate outcome attribution. The AgentPay MCP is the hard execution gate; the companion CLI exposes the same operator workflow.
defaultPrompt: Safely discover a product and run the AgentPay purchase flow.
Explain why this AgentPay purchase was blocked or declined.
Check AgentPay connectivity and explain its enforcement boundary.
